intent: Bring historically evidenced Lisp-machine methods and restart semantics for D10 owner review, while preserving D2 as sole structural/control authority; proposing names does not mint 10-bit residents

sources.notes: Daniel Weinreb and David Moon era Lisp Machine Flavors; message dispatch; research only
Later Common Lisp standard method precedence and next-method context
Effective method combination order as independent semantic law
Lexical restarts, condition association and explicit invocation; later standard

excluded.reason: already selected history replay; do not duplicate

rows.historical_provenance: Source is the historical design reference, NOT an existing SENS implementation
rows.semantic_law: Given explicit method signatures and argument type evidence, derive the deterministic ordered list of applicable methods; never invoke one
rows.falsifier: Two equally-specific incomparable methods must yield explicit ambiguity unless a ratified precedence law disambiguates
rows.distinct_from_existing: DEFMETHOD and DEFGENERIC already selected: distinguish query/ordering from definition

rows.historical_provenance: Source is the historical design reference, NOT an existing SENS implementation
rows.semantic_law: Inside an admitted effective-method context return exact D1 yes/no for whether another applicable method exists
rows.falsifier: At last primary method answer D1 NO; outside a method context BLOCK rather than truthy NIL
rows.distinct_from_existing: No new D1 resident; D10 library predicate returns the existing D1 value

rows.historical_provenance: Source is the historical design reference, NOT an existing SENS implementation
rows.semantic_law: Delegate to the next ordered method preserving or explicitly replacing arguments under established method-combination semantics
rows.falsifier: Invoking at end or outside dynamic method context must signal defined error, never fall back to guessed function identity
rows.distinct_from_existing: Invocation sequencing may belong to D2 sole language-control owner; do not ratify D10 as new control syntax

rows.historical_provenance: Source is the historical design reference, NOT an existing SENS implementation
rows.semantic_law: Construct an effective-method plan with before, primary, after and around method roles in a specified precedence order
rows.falsifier: Same method set with different registration order must yield identical effective plan when precedence is fully specified
rows.distinct_from_existing: Compare existing DEFGENERIC/DEFMETHOD and ordinary CONS/LIST as representation, not equivalent precedence semantics

rows.historical_provenance: Source is the historical design reference, NOT an existing SENS implementation
rows.semantic_law: Represent failure of explicit message dispatch when no applicable method is available, keeping object/message identity in data
rows.falsifier: A method-not-found case must not invent an execution result or silently select another method
rows.distinct_from_existing: Possibly merely an existing explicit error result; require independent observable law before D10 slot

rows.historical_provenance: Source is the historical design reference, NOT an existing SENS implementation
rows.semantic_law: Present a first-class condition value to an explicitly supplied lexical handler chain without turning it into host I/O
rows.falsifier: Unmatched condition must remain available as typed failure with unmodified payload; no implicit host exception
rows.distinct_from_existing: Signaling/handler control likely belongs to D2 or effect ledger rather than D10 new structural control

rows.historical_provenance: Source is the historical design reference, NOT an existing SENS implementation
rows.semantic_law: Resolve a restart by stable identity in an explicit scope/condition association; return presence or a typed descriptor without executing
rows.falsifier: An out-of-scope restart must fail lookup and never be invoked, with quote/data and source identity preserved
rows.distinct_from_existing: Not equal to already-selected historical UNDO/INTERLISP-HISTORY-REPLAY, which concern historical state

rows.historical_provenance: Source is the historical design reference, NOT an existing SENS implementation
rows.semantic_law: Invoke a selected restart with exact supplied arguments, with scope and continuation preserved
rows.falsifier: Invoking stale/out-of-scope restart BLOCK; no default branch or OS capability is inferred
rows.distinct_from_existing: Nonlocal transfer is control; D2 owns language control; owner must approve a pure functional encoding
